segments.name: Bitcoin mining
products: AI and HPC hosting and leasing
segments.description: Operates owned and leased data centers across Georgia, Tennessee, Mississippi and Wyoming to mine bitcoin, with plans to support AI and HPC workloads.
segments.evidence: The Company has a sole reporting segment which is the bitcoin mining segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns variable consideration in bitcoin from a single third-party mining pool operator in exchange for contributing computing power to the pool.
revenueModel.evidence: We obtain bitcoin as a result of our mining operations by contributing all of our computing power to a single mining pool operator, who is currently our sole customer.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025, the company's co-location hosting arrangement in New York expired and wind-down commenced.
